profiles.use_case: Review, explicitly accept, authorize once, execute, settle, and inspect one exclusive local creation of a bounded text file.
required_capabilities: retained evidence acquisition and currentness support
durable occurrence admission and independent review custody
attempt custody, authority-neutral execution, settlement, and reconciliation
profiles.verified_environment: One disposable Linux x86_64 local installation; provider-backed independent review followed by explicit operator acceptance and one local file effect.
limitations: The frozen successful occurrence is the qualified governed action. The public newcomer procedure verifies its released evidence and exact projection; it does not repeat the paid review or effect.
The Docket-local permission store is an operator-owned profile with a maximum 300-second lifetime and snapshot-currentness for one custody attempt; it is not Standing or a general authority service.
The retained precompiled-cycle lineage is distinct from supervised Maude authoring-session custody.
Settlement success does not establish objective completion or present external state.
Live Slack, Discord, and PagerDuty delivery and human acknowledgment are outside this profile.
Other executors, provider routes, platforms, production deployments, and federation are unsupported by this release.

profiles.use_case: Reproduce the read-only validation of the frozen successful occurrence using public source and released evidence.
limitations: This is consultation and inspection of retained evidence, not another execution.
The occurrence remains settled_observation_required and grants no continuation authority.
